# Louis Rouanet

> Personal academic website of Louis Rouanet, assistant professor of political economy at the University of Florida's Hamilton Center: publications, working papers, book chapters, CV and teaching in political economy and economic history.

Louis Rouanet is an Assistant Professor of Political Economy at the Hamilton School, University of Florida (previously University of Texas at El Paso and Western Kentucky University; PhD George Mason University, 2021) and an Associate Editor at *Public Choice*. His research is in political economy and economic history, with a focus on the French Revolution, revolutionary and Napoleonic France, inflationary finance, military conscription, and the political economy of institutions.

Every paper below that has a PDF on this site also has a plain-text markdown version (the `.md` link). Those text files carry front matter with title, authors, venue, year, an abstract, and the link to the authoritative PDF. `llms-full.txt` concatenates all of them into a single file.

- [Home page](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/): biography, publication list, teaching and contact
- [Curriculum Vitae (text)](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/cv.md): CV in plain text; PDF at https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Louis_Rouanet_s_Resume.pdf
- [All papers in one file](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/llms-full.txt): full text of every paper below
- [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.fr/citations?user=oHFKP-2njvsC)

## Journal articles

- [Assignats or Death : Inflationary Finance in Revolutionary France](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/assignats-or-death-inflationary-finance-in-revolutionary.md): with Bryan Cutsinger and Josh Ingber, European Economic Review, 2023. Following a revolution precipitated by unsustainable government deficits, an explosion of paper money called the assignat caused a rapid increase in prices not seen in Europe again until the widespread adoption of discretionary fiat… PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Assignats-EER.pdf
- [Drafting the Great Army](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/drafting-the-great-army.md): with Ennio Piano, Journal of Economic History, 2022. Napoléon Bonaparte revolutionized the practice of war with his reliance on a mass national army and large-scale conscription. This system faced one major obstacle: draft evasion. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Rouanet_JEH.pdf
- [Foutu Maximum : The political economy of price controls and national defense in revolutionary France.](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/foutu-maximum-the-political-economy-of-price-controls.md): Explorations in Economic History, 2022. War necessitates both allocating real resources to defense and certain interest groups being in favor of the government raising resources to wage war. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/The_political_Economy_of_Price_controls_in_revolutionary_france-27.pdf
- [Externalities and COVID-19](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/externalities-and-covid-19.md): with Peter Leeson, Southern Economic Journal, 2021. Negative infectious-disease externalities are less prevalent in the absence of government intervention and less costly to society than is often supposed. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Leeson_Rouanet_Externality-and-Covid-19.pdf
- [The Calculus of American Indian Consent: The law and economics of tribal constitutions](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/the-calculus-of-american-indian-consent-the-law.md): with Ennio Piano, Public Choice, 2022. American Indians living on reservation are the poorest demographic in the United States. A growing literature suggests that tribal political institutions are at least in part to blame for such poor economic performance. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Native_American_Constitutions-9.pdf
- [The Redistributive Politics of Monetary Policy](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3727543): with Peter Hazlett, Public Choice, 2022. (external link; no text version on this site)
- [Can Geography Explain Quebec's Historical Poverty ?](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/can-geography-explain-quebecs-historical-poverty.md): with Vincent Geloso, Southern Economic Journal. From the 19th century to the 1940’s, Quebec remained poorer and less economically developed than the rest of Canada in general and poorer than Ontario in particular. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Geography_and_wages_in_colonial_Canada-12.pdf
- [The Interest group origins of the Bank of France](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/the-interest-group-origins-of-the-bank-of-france.md): Public Choice, 2021. This paper contrasts different interpretations of the creation of the Bank of France. I argue that the Bank of France was the product of rent-seeking behavior rather than the pursuit of public interest, as is commonly supposed. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Rouanet2019_Article_TheInterestGroupOriginsOfTheBa.pdf
- [Ethnogenesis and Statelessness](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3448582): with Vincent Geloso, European Journal of Law and Economics, 2023. (external link; no text version on this site)
- [Filling the ranks : Military replacement in post-revolutionary France](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/filling-the-ranks-military-replacement-in-post-revolutionary.md): with Ennio Piano, European Review of Economic History, 2019. Many economists have analyzed the efficiency of a volunteered army relative to a conscripted army. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/JMP_Rouanet.pdf
- [Desertion as Theft](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/desertion-as-theft.md): with Ennio Piano, Journal of Institutional Economics, 2019. To be effective, an army must contain the extent of desertion among its ranks. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/desertion_as_theft.pdf
- [Economic Calculation and the Organization of Markets](https://link.springer.com/epdf/10.1007/s11138-018-0425-4?shared_access_token=lZDtCl7ay3Ip5aX-Ml2PP_e4RwlQNchNByi7wbcMAY454GsQ6suSMNBNH6VoFn337Qq2iSfcStfZplIJSBsV7uaPm8Sjexj9bfPxboEuf6BBAX8CEOO7ZOmoFoT0sIZSsUHaLFszjdQNmPFzWQnR-cpi6M4c_MYKY2oPencmPQI%3D): with Ennio Piano, The Review of Austrian Economics, 2018. (external link; no text version on this site)
- [Competition is (still) a tough weed : a review essay of Thomas Philippon's The Great Reversal](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/competition-is-still-a-tough-weed-a-review-essay-of-thomas.md): The Review of Austrian Economics, 2020. In The Great Reversal, Philippon makes the case that competition in America has weakened during the past two decades. His book contributes to the rapidly developing literature on the macroeconomic consequences of market power. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Rouanet_competition_is_still_a_though_weed.pdf

## Working Papers

- [Long live the Republic: The political consequences of revolutionary land redistribution](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/long-live-the-republic-the-political-consequences.md): with Ronan Tallec, R&R at Journal of political economy, 2024. To be politically viable, a Revolution needs the support of key interest groups that benefit from the survival of the new regime. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Rouanet_Tallec_Long_Live_Republic_site.pdf
- [The Politics of Railroads](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/the-politics-of-railroads.md): with Ronan Tallec and Anne Alonzo, 2024. Infrastructure programs are eminently political projects whose allocation is not simply the result of concerns about economic efficiency. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/RTA_The_Politics_of_Railroads_3-14-2025.pdf
- [The Failure of French Democratic Socialism](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/the-failure-of-french-democratic-socialism.md): 2022. The attempt to implement democratic socialism in France following Francois Mitterrand’s election in 1981 is directly responsible for France’s economic underperformance since. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/The_Failure_of_French_Democratic_Socialism-16.pdf
- [Democracy, Dictatorship, and the Monetary Commons](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/democracy-dictatorship-and-the-monetary-commons.md): with Bryan Cutsinger, 2020. In this paper, we analyze the effect that alternative decision-making structures have on equilibrium inflation rates. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Hyperinflation_and_Rent_seeking-16.pdf
- [Utility maximization and dissipation under price controls](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3588136): SSRN, 2020. (external link; no text version on this site)

## Book chapters

- [Introduction to A Research Agenda for Austrian Economics](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/introduction-to-a-research-agenda-for-austrian-economics.md): Edward Elgar. Introductory chapter of A Research Agenda for Austrian Economics (Edward Elgar): what the Austrian tradition brings to applied economics and where its research program should go. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/9781800882263-book-part-9781800882263-6.pdf
- [Austrian Economics and Economic Policy](https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/papers/austrian-economics-and-economic-policy.md): Economic Policy and the History of Economic Thought. Surveys the Austrian school's approach to economic policy, from Menger, Böhm-Bawerk and Wieser through Mises and Hayek to contemporary work. PDF: https://louisrouanet-econ.github.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Chapter_Leeson.pdf
